Zora Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 18 |durability = 20 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Silver Shield}} [[Silver Shield]]s are [[Zora]]-made [[Shield]]s known for their intricate ornamentation. It is believed that true masters of these Shields can redirect attacks like a rock redirecting rushing water. Silver Shields belong to the [[Zora Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all [[Weapon]]s created by the Zora.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 173}} There are five scattered across [[Hyrule|Hyrule Kingdom]], a majority of which are in the [[Lanayru Great Spring]] and in and around [[Lake Hylia]]. An additional two are stowed away in [[Treasure Chest]]s in [[Master Mode]]. They are found at the following locations: * The west bridge of [[Zora's Domain]] * Within a Treasure Chest underneath the throne room of Zora's Domain * Inside a Treasure Chest in the middle of [[Lake Akkala]], off the west side of [[Dah Hesho Shrine]] * In a wooden Treasure Chest at the southeast shore of [[Lake Hylia]], north of the lone [[Tree]]. * A Treasure Chest just off the west coast of [[Eventide Island]] Silver Shields are made of metal, and will therefore conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s. They also will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]] like wooden Shields. Though they sink in water, they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_025" |Life = 20 |GuardPower = 18 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 7 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 14 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 10 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 15 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 26 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 24 |durability = 20 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Zora Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Zora Shields reappear in {{TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Zora Shields can be wielded by [[Link]] in conjunction with [[Zora Sword]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Shield * Zora Gear }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Shields, Zora Gear |items= TotK, AoC }}
